item.title: Lawsuit alleges Google's Gemini guided man to consider 'mass casualty' event before suicide
item.description: A lawsuit alleges that Google's artificial intelligence chatbot Gemini guided a 36-year-old man on a mission to stage a "catastrophic accident."

item.title: Houston's weather pattern turns stormier this weekend and for part of Spring Break
item.description: We'll be monitoring the sky for spring-like thunderstorms this weekend and the middle of next week.

item.title: Video shows 'Spiderman from Hell' who police believe is responsible for multiple Montrose break-ins
item.description: Investigators are looking for a man described by a neighbor as 'Spiderman from Hell', who they believe is responsible for at least seven burglaries in Montrose since December.

item.title: ﻿FBI searching for "Coverall Crook" in string of grocery store bank robberies in northwest Houston
item.description: The FBI is asking for the public's help in identifying a man suspected of robbing banks located inside grocery stores in northwest Houston over the past two weeks.

item.title: Remains displaced from historic Black cemetery in Fifth Ward to be reinterred
item.description: After nearly a century of displacement, the remains of 39 Black Americans buried in Fifth Ward's Historic Evergreen Negro Cemetery will be reinterred on Thursday.

item.title: City of Houston delays launch of new heavy trash pickup system
item.description: The City of Houston is delaying a new system designed to take the guesswork out of heavy trash pickup, as neighbors continue to report missed pickups.

item.title: ABC News Price Tracker shows how rising grocery and home prices have changed in Houston area
item.description: Using the most recent data available, the ABC News Price Tracker can show you which grocery items have seen the largest price hikes nationwide and how housing costs have changed both nationwide and locally.

item.title: Six arrested in gold coin scheme targeting seniors, Friendswood PD says
item.description: Friendswood police call it an elaborate scheme to defraud people, involving suspects posing as federal employees, and gold coins.

item.title: 'Hundreds and hundreds' of pieces of mail recovered from theft suspect's house: Jersey Village PD
item.description: Jersey Village police say they've arrested a prolific mail thief after investigating him for more than a year.

item.title: Woman charged with murder after husband found shot to death in New Caney, authorities say
item.description: Lonnie Moore was found shot to death inside a running vehicle, the morning of June 15, 2025. Nine months later, authorities said an investigation led them to his wife's arrest.
